description: This Java class represents the response to a delete feature properties command within the Eclipse Ditto framework. It encapsulates details such as the Thing ID, feature ID, HTTP status, and headers, and provides methods for creating instances from JSON and string inputs, as well as serialization and equality checks.

classes.name: DeleteFeaturePropertiesResponse
classes.description: Immutable class representing the response to a delete feature properties command, including JSON serialization/deserialization, and response metadata.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a response object from ThingId, featureId, and headers.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a response object from a JSON string or JSON object along with headers.

methods.name: getThingEntityId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the Thing associated with this response.

methods.name: getFeatureId
methods.description: Returns the feature ID whose properties were deleted.

methods.name: setDittoHeaders
methods.description: Returns a new response object with updated Ditto headers.

methods.name: appendPayload
methods.description: Serializes the response payload into JSON, applying schema version and predicate filtering.
